messages:
olivia: FYI opened a docs PR to consolidate rate-limit header examples and add a migration checklist for v2 header names. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4890

marc: Nice. Can we include both curl + python-sdk + node examples? Callouts for case-sensitivity would be helpful (some proxies downcase headers).

olivia: Added curl and Node fetch. Python uses `from redwood import Client`. Snippet shows `headers = {'x-redwood-rate-tier': 'gold'}` and a short table: legacy header -> new header.

kevin: Suggestion: add a small note under "Quotas" to explain how tier assignment affects billing.tier_label metric and the dashboard panel mapping. I can add a screenshot of the panel if needed.

liz: I can export the panel today (320x180). Also, docs-bot: can you generate a staging preview once the PR is updated?

docs-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-4890--docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits/migration (expires in 7 days).

marc: Quick nit: Dedicated customers have reserve-first consumption. Reword "burst unlimited" to "burst after reserve is consumed".

kevin: Added the Dedicated clause. Also added a short migration checklist step: 1) Pin SDK to >=0.9.2, 2) Update headers, 3) Validate with curl against staging.

olivia: Thanks — running a quick smoke locally and will merge when staging preview looks ok.

liz: Preview looks good to me. Merging in 10m unless anyone objects.

olivia: Merged. I'll follow up with a PR to add the final dashboard panel image and an example of the metering query for `billing.tier_assigned`.
